summary: Retest of iteration 1's bug + regression. The login-toast bug is FIXED: errMessage() in frontend/src/lib/queries.ts now returns the backend's real `detail` string first (for any status, not just non-401), so the login page correctly shows 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.' instead of 'Sua sessão expirou'. The register-rate-limit criterion is verified at the backend (429 with the exact new message 'Muitas tentativas em pouco tempo...') and confirmed by code review that Register.tsx's catch also uses the same fixed errMessage() helper, so the UI will surface that 429 detail too. Per the briefing's 'no máximo 1 tentativa de cadastro' instruction, that single register attempt was spent on the backend pytest run (which returned 429, confirming the Supabase quota is still exhausted in this environment) - the browser registration check was intentionally NOT re-run to avoid a second attempt; its script was updated to accept both 201 and 429 outcomes for the next time quota is available. All 14 previously-passing regression checks (7 backend + 10 browser, note: some backend tests cover multiple regression assertions) were re-run and still pass.

action_items.description: Supabase email-send quota (~2/hour) is still exhausted in this environment from prior runs, so /api/auth/register returns 429 (now with the correct clear message) instead of 201. This is expected per spec_deviations and is NOT an app bug - the backend test asserts the exact 429 detail text. The browser check 'register-shows-confirm-email-toast' was not re-executed this iteration (to respect the 'max 1 registration attempt' instruction, already spent on the backend test) but was updated to handle both the 201 and 429 outcomes; code review confirms Register.tsx uses the same fixed errMessage() helper so the 429 detail will render correctly once quota resets.
